clusters.label: progression_from_simple_to_complex
clusters.description: The organizing principle involves structuring the literature review by moving from basic or foundational concepts, models, or applications toward more advanced, specialized, or complex ones, often including validation, optimization, or detailed analysis.
example_descriptions: progression from foundational models to specialized applications and optimization
progression from model structure to assumptions and limitations
from foundational model to specialized features and applications
progression from simplified to realistic models and empirical validation
progression from application to model details, comparison, and results
clusters.llm_reasoning: The organizing principle of 'progression_from_simple_to_complex' reflects a structural narrative rather than a thematic, theoretical, methodological, chronological, debate-based, or analytical-level categorization, making it distinct from the pre-defined dimensions.

clusters.label: Foundational to Applied Progression
clusters.description: A structure where literature is grouped based on a progression from basic concepts or theories to more specific, applied, or advanced developments within the field.
example_descriptions: progression from foundational concepts to applications and implications
progression from foundational concepts to specific applications
progression from foundational concepts to specific applications
progression from foundational concepts to specific components and applications
progression from foundational concepts to specific applications and empirical bases
clusters.llm_reasoning: The 'Foundational to Applied Progression' captures a conceptual developmental trajectory not directly aligned with any of the six predefined dimensions, which focus on thematic, theoretical, methodological, chronological, debate-based, or analytical-level groupings.

clusters.label: by component or model type
clusters.description: Groups literature based on the type of components, models, systems, or approaches used in the research.
example_descriptions: by application to specific measurement types
by type of measurement approach
by component type in the methodology
by component of the system
by component of the system
clusters.llm_reasoning: The organizing principle 'by component or model type' aligns closely with the 'methodology' dimension, as it focuses on the technical approaches, models, and components used in research.

clusters.label: methodological approach
clusters.description: Grouping literature based on the research methods or techniques used in the studies.
example_descriptions: by methodological process
by methodological process
by methodological process
by methodological approach
by methodological approach
clusters.llm_reasoning: The cluster's organizing principle of grouping by 'methodological approach' aligns directly with the pre-defined 'methodology' dimension, which also groups literature by research methods or technical approaches used.

clusters.label: progression_from_foundations_to_applications
clusters.description: A structure where literature is grouped based on a conceptual progression from fundamental theories or mathematical foundations toward more applied, advanced, or specific physical phenomena and their implications.
example_descriptions: progression from classical to quantum and from abstract to applied concepts
progression from theoretical setup to numerical results and observed phenomena
progression from structural foundations to advanced phenomena and applications
progression from classical to quantized structures and their classification and application
progression from mathematical foundations to physical applications
clusters.llm_reasoning: The organizing principle reflects a conceptual depth progression from foundational to applied, which is not directly captured by any of the six predefined dimensions.

clusters.label: increasing complexity and abstraction
clusters.description: Groups literature based on the progression of concepts, models, or systems from simpler to more complex and abstract forms.
example_descriptions: increasing complexity and theoretical extension
increasing complexity and computational approach
by increasing structural complexity and abstraction
by increasing abstraction and modeling complexity
by increasing abstraction and structural complexity
clusters.llm_reasoning: The organizing principle of 'increasing complexity and abstraction' captures a progression in the sophistication and theoretical depth of models or systems, which is not directly aligned with any of the six predefined dimensions.
